g.text: ARIMAX benchmark with real GDP per capita and COVID controls
Economic and demographic paths are fixed; intervals do not include scenario or model-selection uncertainty
ARIMA intervals include future innovation uncertainty but hold estimated parameters fixed. OLS uses a conventional prediction interval.
